notes: The texts of each project: data/config/dti/contract_texts.csv

text:
"$dtiContract_intro" $HeOrShe turns the survey toward you. "$dtiContract_problem"

"Bring $dtiContract_goodsList here: $dtiContract_cargo units of cargo. You can bring it in parts. We pay you $dtiContract_reward when the last part arrives. With your goods and your Eridani-Utopia plans, our crews can do the rest."
notes: Eridani-Utopia contracts: the first line is one of three (ContractMission.INTROS)

text: "You brought goods for the $dtiContract_structureName project? Good. We still need $dtiContract_remaining."
options:
dtiContract_deliver:Deliver what you carry
cutCommLink:Cut the comm link

script:
Call $dtiContract_ref deliver
FireBest DtiContractDeliveredText
Call $dtiContract_ref finishIfDone
FireAll PopulateOptions

text: "That is all of it. Here is your payment. Our crews start the work today."
